analysis.title: AI & Automation Consultant
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong professional experience in capacity planning, performance engineering, and Python automation, with practical AI applications in current work (Copilot, AI-assisted reporting, research into LLM knowledge bases). However, the role requires 5+ years of consulting/enterprise architecture experience and 3+ years specifically in AI-powered enterprise search/knowledge management, which the candidate's professional history does not clearly demonstrate. The candidate's AI evidence is mostly practical/project-based, not enterprise consulting. The role also emphasizes stakeholder interviews, workshops, and strategic roadmaps, which are not prominent in the candidate's profile.
strengths: Strong Python automation and ETL skills with production evidence (CITI, current role).
Practical AI experience: Copilot, AI-assisted reporting, RAG, agentic workflows (personal project).
Deep expertise in capacity planning, forecasting, and performance engineering (CITI, G6, CA).
Experience with enterprise tools: Dynatrace, BMC TrueSight, CA APM, Splunk, SQL Server.
Consulting background at CA Technologies (SME for CA APM) with client training.
Project evidence: AWS lakehouse with Text-to-SQL agent, AI job-search pipeline (personal).
gaps: No explicit professional experience in AI-powered enterprise search or knowledge management (required 3+ years).
No clear consulting or enterprise architecture experience in the last 5+ years (current role is capacity specialist, not consultant).
No evidence of conducting stakeholder interviews, workshops, or delivering strategic roadmaps.
No experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, or Kilo (preferred).
No certifications in Azure, AI, Automation, or Enterprise Architecture.
Current AI work is practical/reporting-focused, not enterprise-wide AI solution assessment.
tailoring_plan: Highlight current AI-assisted reporting and knowledge base research as evidence of AI-powered knowledge management, even though it's not production.
Emphasize CA Technologies consulting experience (sizing, monitoring design, client training) to demonstrate consulting skills.
Frame the AWS lakehouse project and AI job-search pipeline as examples of evaluating and recommending AI tools.
Quantify automation impact where possible (e.g., capacity report automation, ETL efficiency) to show operational efficiency gains.
Address the gap in enterprise search by mentioning familiarity with RAG and FAISS from personal projects.
Prepare to discuss how to conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops, using examples from past roles (e.g., gathering requirements for capacity tools).
